text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...One, two, one, two.
――――*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Hrm.
I'm having a tough time with this part......

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……Whoa!?
T-Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Um... I was hoping to practice
when there's no one else around...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Taking lessons right next to the other Umamusume makes me feel kind of shy...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...Ever since I was little, I've seen plenty of Umamusume who belong on stage far more than I do."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
But... no matter how much I practice alone,
I just can't shake this feeling that something's off...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...Maybe the stage really doesn't suit me after all...?"
choice_data_list: Still, you were practicing the center choreography, weren't you?
Still, you were practicing the center choreography, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I know what I'm saying and what I'm doing don't match... but still...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......U-Um...
Even I... Even I can......!
choice_data_list: I think anyone can be the star!
The fans are waiting for your performance.
The fans are waiting for your performance.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......U-Um...
Even I... Even I can......!
choice_data_list: I think anyone can be the star!
The fans are waiting for your performance.
The fans are waiting for your performance.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: The "lead role"... You're right.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...A "great Umamusume"
is surely great on stage as well...
choice_data_list: Don't hold back, let's dance freely and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a slightly lighter heart, Cheval Grand
danced more confidently than usual,
making it a fruitful practice session.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"M-'My'... performance...
Yes, you're right..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I can't just compare myself to others and get depressed...!
choice_data_list: I'll be watching from here as a fan!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-That's a little embarrassing...
...but yes... I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her spirits lifted, Cheval Grand danced with more vigor than usual, making for a truly productive practice session.
